consumer: write_tiles' per-tile loop reading map::ter(p)/map::furn(p) to record each nearby tile's raw terrain and furniture id into the snapshot
scope: per-tile terrain/furniture over the nearby export window (a map region around the center)
decisive_source: src/arcopolis_export.cpp::write_tiles — its body calls ctx.m.ter(p).id().str() and ctx.m.furn(p).id().str(), reading the map grid's raw authoritative terrain/furniture id (e.g. "t_floor", "f_null"), not a computed predicate or a display-filtered view
divergence: a tile whose furniture was just bashed/removed (furn becomes f_null in raw map state) but a wrong answer reports the stale f_table id — raw simulation-state divergence, not a display lag
